notes:
User is planning a November trip to the Japanese Alps in Nagano Prefecture with friends from Tokyo, considering public transportation and the Hokuriku Shinkansen. They chose Matsumoto for traditional culture/history and convenient access to the Japanese Alps Visitor Center, with possible nearby onsen (Asama, Utsukushigahara, Hirata). Planned sights: Japanese Alps Visitor Center, Matsumoto Castle, Nawate Street, Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum, and Zenko-ji Temple. Matsumoto Castle is the priority; Zenko-ji is in Nagano City, so transportation/time need checking.

User is also planning a day trip to Yokohama and especially wants Minato Mirai 21 and Red Brick Warehouse for harbor views. Other interests include Chinatown, Sankeien Garden, autumn foliage/illuminations, beer, and seafood. They mentioned kanimeshi (kaisendon/kaiseki? clarify intended crab dish) and namashirasu, plus grilled squid. They noted Kanemasa and “Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nohatsu Ichiba” (this Tokyo name/location may be mistaken; verify before recommending) and may visit Yokohama Central Market.

They want current details on Yokohama Oktoberfest, Autumn Leaves Festival, and Minato Mirai 21 illuminations. Avoid asserting unverified themes/installations: the previously mentioned “Maple Leaf Tunnel,” “Harvest Moon Garden,” etc. may be fabricated. Check official Yokohama/Minato Mirai event calendars and dates, and ask the user’s travel dates.

Personal context: User recently moved from abroad to Tokyo and has lived in a studio in Harajuku for about 3 months (earlier note said 1 month, so update to 3 months). They enjoy discovering hidden gems, especially on Sunday neighborhood walks, and recently found a good coffee shop in Daikanyama. They are enjoying Tokyo’s fall foliage. They have not yet explored Harajuku’s historical side much and plan to visit Meiji Shrine and Kawai Shrine. Any information about Kawai Shrine—including claimed “Lucky Bell,” gardens, and deity associations—should be fact-checked because the prior response may be inaccurate.
